fusions.name: Puffball Tread
fusions.desc: Each step releases spores that deal 6 poison damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leave them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Burst Caps
fusions.desc: A stamp that deals 18 poison damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Burrow Bedding
fusions.desc: Grows a bed of moss where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Breeding Colony
fusions.desc: Every hit you land plants a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all burst at once, striking it for 34% of your weapon damage per stack, 204% at full. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
